name: devrecap
description: Reconstruct evidence-backed developer work from authorized local coding history and let Codex turn it into polished recaps.

interface.shortDescription: Turn coding history into AI-written work recaps.
interface.longDescription: DevRecap reconstructs what you actually worked on from explicitly authorized local Codex/Claude history and read-only Git evidence. Codex then synthesizes those structured facts into polished daily standups, weekly reviews, sprint recaps, and memory reports without inventing completed work.
defaultPrompt: Use DevRecap to help me remember what I worked on this week.
Use DevRecap to prepare my daily standup in Portuguese.
Use DevRecap to create a detailed review of the last 14 days.
